query.text: 请帮我照看狗狗，有危险或需要关注的情况时及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch over the dog and alert me promptly to danger or situations needing attention.

annotation.text_zh: 狗狗跳上茶几开始嚎叫了，注意跌落风险。
annotation.text_en: The dog jumped onto the coffee table and is howling, watch out so it doesn't fall.

annotation.text_zh: 狗狗在茶几上趴下了，目前情绪有所稳定。
annotation.text_en: The dog has laid down on the coffee table and seems calmer now.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
